Question: For real numbers \(x,\) let \[ \begin{aligned} P(x) &= 1 + \cos(x) + i\sin(x) \\ &\quad {}- \cos(2x) - i\sin(2x) \\ &\quad {}+ \cos(3x) + i\sin(3x) \end{aligned} \] where \(i = \sqrt{-1}.\) For how many values of \(x\) with \(0 \le x \lt 2\pi\) does \[P(x) = 0?\]
